title: Reduced high-risk runtime interference in analyst routing and answers
points: Removed post-answer semantic rewrites for source-unit claims, ROIC horizon wording, and numeric-screen narrative-gap wording so runtime no longer changes analyst meaning after generation.
Restricted model-build runtime support lanes to explicit model-building requests instead of broad projected-financials language.
Aligned the secondary deterministic model-build detector with the same explicit-intent boundary, so vague projected-financials wording no longer bypasses router guards.
Made model-build support retrieval industry-aware, so bank and cement model inputs request sector-appropriate fields instead of generic industrial fields.

Preserved exact bank deposit labels such as individual deposits in numeric retrieval concepts and deposit-schedule ranking, so the workpaper keeps the user-requested label instead of drifting to nearby customer/FI deposit tables.

Added narrow support lanes for latest-quarter industry performance, top-company bear-market profit protection, and one-page profitability/valuation summaries so analyst context includes the ratios, peer scope, and period evidence needed for the answer.
Stopped analyst table pivots from silently overwriting duplicate metric-period cells; conflicting values are now preserved together in the rendered analyst context.
